authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL danta explicitly gives regional dā̃t tooth across Nepali, Bihari, Hindi and western IA, alongside dand and the proposed Nepali dā̃d stage. The selected dãṭ/ḍãṭ/ḍaṭ/ḍãt/dath and Dotyali dā̃dā tooth responses fit this family with source dental/retroflex notation, nasalization, aspiration spelling and final vowel retained. Local IA transmission is unresolved. The separate non-nasal Dotyali dāḍā and longer compound/extended tooth forms are excluded for separate review. Exact response: dā̃dā.
